fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Up to three jobs in every arrival window

Brightline Appliance Repair has three vans and caps each 4-hour arrival window at three jobs. Customers enter a ZIP code and the appliance, then choose a window with room left. Full windows drop off the form. Addresses outside the 14 ZIP codes Brightline covers get the office phone number instead of a slot.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
The 11th room hour shows its $25 price first

Every desk at Harbor Street Commons comes with 10 meeting-room hours a month. Each room request shows the member how many of those hours are left. Time past the allowance is priced at $25 an hour before the member confirms, and it goes on their account for the month.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { equipmentRentals: "I run Foundry Makerspace. Build a booking form for our laser cutter in 2-hour blocks. Members enter their member number first. Check it against our training records, and show open blocks only to members who have the laser safety course on file. Anyone without it should see the next class date and a sign-up link instead.", repairVisits: "My appliance repair company, Brightline, has three vans. Build a booking form with 4-hour arrival windows that each take at most three jobs. Customers enter a ZIP code and the appliance, then pick a window with room left. Hide a window once it is full. If the ZIP code is not one of the 14 we cover, show our office phone number.", photoSessions: "I'm a portrait photographer. Build a booking form where clients pick a date, a session type and a location, then pay a $150 deposit through Stripe. Hold the date for 24 hours and release it if the deposit is not paid. For a $600 family session, email a request for the $450 balance seven days before the shoot.", meetingRooms: "I manage Harbor Street Commons, a coworking space. Each desk member gets 10 meeting-room hours a month. Build a room booking form that shows each member the hours they have left. When a booking goes past the allowance, show the $25 hourly rate for the extra time before they confirm, and add the charge to their monthly account." };
